cohort: The study included 187 female patients of child-bearing age (>=15 years) diagnosed with chronic pancreatitis.
finding: The frequency and severity of painful exacerbations of chronic pancreatitis were significantly lower during pregnancy compared with prepregnancy and postpregnancy periods, and there was no increased risk of adverse maternal and fetal outcomes.
followup_time: Observations were made before, during, and after pregnancy, but a specific post-pregnancy follow-up duration is not mentioned.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was an outcome measured, but specific birth weight criteria for inclusion are not mentioned.
gest_age: Preterm delivery was an outcome measured, but specific gestational age criteria for inclusion are not mentioned.
